_: Copy this to .kbfix.json in your project, or to ~/.kbfix.json for the whole machine. Project wins over home. Every field is optional; what is shown here is the default.
_directions: Which way round to look. Drop one to switch that direction off, for example ["he->en"] to detect only English typed on the Hebrew layout. The generic aliases "b->a" and "a->b" work for any pair.
_minSignalChars: Below this many letters there is not enough evidence either way, so it says nothing. Lowering it will start guessing at things like /pr.
_minTargetScore: How much the transposed text has to read like real prose, 0 to 1.
_minMargin: How far the transposition has to beat the original. This is the gate that keeps ordinary prompts safe, because real prose scores near 1 in its own language and nothing can beat it by this much. Raising either threshold makes it quieter; lowering them makes it guess.
